items.exampleEn: Our dog had five puppies last week.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的狗上週生了五隻小狗。

items.exampleEn: A tornado is a very strong wind that turns in a circle.
items.exampleZh: 龍捲風是一種旋轉的強風。

items.exampleEn: We rode a camel on our desert trip.
items.exampleZh: 我們在沙漠旅行時騎了駱駝。

items.exampleEn: Many animals are in danger of extinction.
Close the hatch before the rain comes in.
items.exampleZh: 在雨水打進來之前把艙口關上。

items.exampleEn: The thunder was so loud that the windows shook.
items.exampleZh: 雷聲大到窗戶都在震動。

items.exampleEn: The waterfall is fifty meters high.
items.exampleZh: 這座瀑布有五十公尺高。
海豚是非常聰明的動物。

items.sentenceEn: The thunder woke the baby up.

items.audioEn: Stay inside! A tornado is coming, and it will be here in ten minutes.
items.audioZh: 待在室內！龍捲風來了，十分鐘內就會到這裡。

items.sentenceEn: The puppy followed me all the way home.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻小狗一路跟著我回家。

items.sentenceEn: The children laughed when the camel made a funny face.
items.sentenceZh: 駱駝做了個滑稽的表情，孩子們都笑了。

items.stemEn: We sat by the ____ and listened to the water falling onto the rocks.
items.stemZh: 我們坐在瀑布旁，聽著水落在岩石上的聲音。

items.stemEn: A baby ____ swims next to its mother in the sea for years.
items.stemZh: 小海豚會在海裡跟在媽媽身邊好幾年。

items.passageEn: Last night, my family watched a nature show on TV. First, it showed a huge waterfall in a faraway jungle. Then we saw a group of dolphins playing near a boat. A sailor opened the hatch and climbed up to take photos of them. Next, the show visited a desert, where camels can walk for days without water. The show also talked about extinction: some animals may disappear forever. Then a tornado appeared on the screen. In the middle of the show, we heard loud thunder outside, and the power went out. Our new puppy was so scared that it hid under the sofa. It was a memorable night.
items.passageZh: 昨晚，我們全家在電視上看了一個自然節目。首先，節目介紹了遠方叢林裡一座巨大的瀑布。接著，我們看到一群海豚在一艘船附近玩耍。一名水手打開艙口，爬上來拍牠們的照片。後來節目來到沙漠，那裡的駱駝可以好幾天不喝水一直走。節目還談到滅絕：有些動物可能會永遠消失。接著，螢幕上出現了一個龍捲風。節目進行到一半，外面傳來很大的雷聲，接著就停電了。我們家的新小狗嚇得躲到沙發底下。那真是難忘的一夜。

questions.questionZh: 水手打開艙口後發生了什麼？
options: 海豚把一條魚送給了他

questions.questionZh: 小狗為什麼躲到沙發底下？

referenceEn: Dolphins love to play with people.
Dolphins really like playing with people.
rubricZh: dolphin 表示「海豚」，例如 a group of dolphins 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 puppy 造一個句子，說說你和小狗的經驗或願望。
referenceEn: I want to have a puppy someday.
I always play with my neighbor's puppy.
rubricZh: puppy 表示「小狗」，例如 a cute puppy 等說法
說的是自己的經驗或想法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）
